name: Timer & Stopwatch
description: A precise stopwatch with laps and a countdown timer with presets, alarm and notification.
prompt: A stopwatch with laps that marks the fastest and slowest, and a countdown timer with quick presets, a ring that empties, an alarm sound, vibration and a notification when time is up.
